name: A Vintage Wren
old_description: We are a family owned and operated custom furniture business located in beautiful Goffstown NH, where we work closely with you on your specific needs, creating each unique piece by hand for you.
about:
A Vintage Wren is a family-owned custom furniture shop based in Goffstown, New Hampshire. Founded by a husband-and-wife team—the woodworker and his partner—the business began in a small house on a rocky hillside where they crafted pieces by hand for local clients.

The company produces made-to-order furniture including farmhouse dining tables, trestle tables, Shaker-style pieces, modern industrial designs, beds, benches, chairs, and accent tables. Every item is handcrafted from domestically sourced hardwoods, with lumber harvested, sawn, and kiln-dried within New Hampshire. The shop offers full customization on dimensions, wood species, and finish.

A Vintage Wren serves residential customers across New England—New Hampshire, Massachusetts, Vermont, Maine, Rhode Island, and Connecticut. Its pieces are sold directly to homeowners and also through regional design professionals seeking locally made, heirloom-quality furniture.

The founders frame their work as an extension of the “farm-to-table” philosophy, emphasizing a local, sustainable economy. By keeping the supply chain within the state, they aim to deliver furniture that carries the story of New Hampshire’s forests into the homes where it will be used for generations.

name: A W Hoss & Son, Inc.
old_description: A.W. Hoss and Son is Seattle's premiere upholsterer & fine furniture manufacturer. We are experienced, passionate, highly skilled
about:
A.W. Hoss & Son, Inc. has operated from Seattle, Washington since its founding in 1936 by A.W. Hoss. The company continues as a family-run upholstery and fine furniture manufacturer NE in the city's Roosevelt neighborhood.

The shop designs, builds, upholsters, and restores furniture for residential and commercial clients. Capabilities span custom sofas, chairs, banquettes, built-ins, wall panels, and mid-century modern reproductions, using hardwood frames, coil springs, and a range of natural and synthetic fills. The facility houses what the company describes as the largest upholstery showroom in the metro area, stocking commercial-grade fabrics from lines such as Robert Allen, Kravet, and Duralee, alongside a green product line featuring recycled polyester, linen, flax, latex, soy-based foam, and reclaimed wood. A retail section sells DIY upholstery supplies including foam and fabric by the yard.

Clients span hospitality, corporate, institutional, and residential sectors. Hotel and restaurant accounts include Four Seasons, Hyatt Regency, The Westin, W Hotels, and local venues such as Blu Water Bistro and Salish Lodge. Corporate and institutional work covers Microsoft, the University of Washington, Virginia Mason Medical Center, Woodland Park Zoo, and the Frye Art Museum. Retail and entertainment projects have been delivered for Nordstrom, Nike Town, Simon Malls, and the Fifth Avenue Theatre.

The company emphasizes sustainable materials and antique restoration expertise as differentiators. Its "Green is our game" program specifies recycled and natural fabrics, latex and soy foams, and renewable wood. Craftsmen also specialize in antique repair, hand tufting, and Chesterfield-style work, positioning the shop as a resource for both historic preservation and new custom builds.

about:
A&E Unique LLC, also operating as Red Lion Apparel LLC, is based in Denver, Colorado, where it runs a home office The company focuses on custom-decorated apparel for business promotion, team sports, memorials, and personal expression. No founding year or ownership structure is publicly disclosed.

The shop produces custom branded clothing using direct-to-film (DTF) printing, rhinestone application, glitter flake, vinyl cutting, reflective material, and other heat-pressed media. It offers design assistance, accepting customer artwork and providing estimates based on quantity. All work is performed in-house at the Denver location, though the company does not disclose facility size, headcount, or annual volume.

Customers include local businesses seeking promotional shirts, sports teams needing uniforms, families ordering memorial wear, and automotive enthusiasts such as the North Denver Red Lion Car Club. The company also serves individuals looking for inspirational or personal statement garments.

The business emphasizes quality garments that make wearers feel confident and comfortable, and it highlights the revival of the Red Lion brand on Denver's north side as a point of distinction.

name: A&J Supply
old_description: A&J Supply is a family operated Farm & Ranch Supply business since 1968. A trusted name that serves a five state area: South Dakota, North Dakota, Wyoming, Montana, Nebraska for over 50 years.
about:
A&J Supply has operated from Whitewood, South Dakota, since 1968 as a family-owned farm and ranch supply business. The company serves a five-state region spanning South Dakota, North Dakota, Wyoming, Montana, and Nebraska.

The business stocks and sells a broad range of products for agricultural and rural customers. Its inventory includes unfinished steel such as angle iron, flat bar, square and round tubing, sheet and plate, expanded metal, and hot- and cold-rolled rounds and pipe. It also carries pressure-treated wood posts, poles, timbers, and boards; general hardware covering plumbing, tools, electrical, paint, automotive, and fasteners; farm and ranch supplies including roller chain, clevises, welding supplies and gases, livestock bedding, and tie-down chain; and workwear from brands such as Carhartt, Levi, Wrangler, Muck Boots, Justin Boots, and Ariat.

Primary customers are farmers, ranchers, and rural property owners across the northern Plains and Mountain West. The company also serves contractors and hobbyists who need metal, lumber, hardware, and welding supplies in the region.

A&J Supply emphasizes its long-standing local presence and family operation as differentiators, promoting quality products at reasonable prices backed by over 50 years of customer service in the same community.

name: A&M Vermont Solar
old_description: Value-driven solar solutions for residential and commercial projects.
about:
Based in Pittsford, Vermont, A&M Vermont Solar provides residential and commercial solar installation services. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure.

The firm designs and installs solar arrays for both residential and commercial customers. Its commercial portfolio includes rooftop and ground‑mounted systems up to 500 kW, such as a 500 kW rooftop array engineered in Manchester, Vermont. Residential installations are typically completed in a single day. The company also offers solar expansion services for existing customers who need additional capacity.

A&M Vermont Solar serves homeowners, commercial property owners, and existing solar system owners looking to expand. Its commercial work demonstrates experience navigating Vermont’s regulatory requirements to bring projects online quickly.

The company emphasizes value‑driven pricing, stating that its bids typically run 20 percent below larger competitors because of low overhead and direct commercial supplier relationships. This cost advantage is passed to customers to make solar more affordable.

name: A-COLOR US LLC
old_description: Professional high-quality custom printing for medium and small businesses.
about:
A-COLOR US LLC operates from Delaware City, Delaware. The company was founded by Daniel Vielma, who serves as General Manager and Owner, growing from a small idea into a provider of custom apparel and printing services.

The shop specializes in screen printing, embroidery, and UV coating for custom apparel, offering a three-step workflow: clients request a quote, approve a digital mock-up, and receive finished goods boxed and shipped. Orders start at a minimum of 12 pieces per design, with a standard turnaround of three to five business days and flat-rate pricing. The team also assists with artwork preparation and accommodates multiple print locations per garment.

Its customer base spans construction, landscaping, restaurant, and retail sectors, serving small and medium-sized businesses that need branded uniforms, promotional wear, or marketing materials. Testimonials highlight responsive communication and quick resolution of production issues.

Vielma started the business from a passion for creativity and a commitment to helping companies stand out, emphasizing collaboration, efficiency, and design innovation as core differentiators. The firm promotes a flat-rate pricing model to simplify budgeting for recurring orders.

name: AAA Spring Specialist Inc
old_description: 1968 AAA Spring has been Utah's #1 suspension products and installation
about:
Founded in 1968 in Salt Lake City, Utah, AAA Spring Specialist Inc began as a suspension products and installation shop serving the Intermountain West. The company has remained a locally operated business for over five decades, building a reputation as Utah’s largest supplier of leaf springs and heavy-duty suspension components.

The company operates a full-service installation and repair facility where every vehicle receives a complimentary suspension inspection. Its on-site warehouse stocks what it describes as the Intermountain West’s largest selection of suspension parts, including leaf springs, air springs, helper kits, Timbren Suspension Enhancement Systems, add-a-leaf kits, bushings, U-bolts, shackles, hangers, shocks, torque rods, and a range of brake components such as drums, overhaul kits, relined shoes, spring brakes, and air-system parts. Custom leaf spring fabrication is also offered.

AAA Spring serves heavy-duty truck fleets, construction equipment operators, and light-duty pickup owners across Utah, Idaho, Colorado, Nevada, Arizona, and New Mexico. Its customer base includes commercial fleets, independent repair shops, and individual vehicle owners seeking suspension upgrades, repairs, or load-capacity increases.

The business emphasizes its four-decade tenure as Utah’s leaf-spring supplier, its free full-suspension inspection policy, and its extensive on-site inventory as key differentiators. These factors, it says, have fostered long-lasting relationships and a name throughout the region.

name: AC Premium Auto
old_description: Find quality OEM and used auto parts fast from premium suppliers across the USA
about:
AC Premium Auto operates from Albuquerque, New Mexico, where it sources and supplies used OEM automotive parts from a network of premium salvage yards across the United States. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The business focuses on providing a broad inventory of recycled original-equipment components, including engines, transmissions, ABS control modules, rear axle assemblies, alternators, drive shafts, side-view mirrors, tail lights, and headlights. Each unit is described as tested, inspected, and verified for fitment and performance before shipment, offering a cost-effective alternative to new replacements.

Its customer base spans automotive repair shops, collision centers, and individual vehicle owners seeking reliable used parts with nationwide delivery. The company emphasizes its ability to ship parts quickly from its supplier network to locations throughout the country.

AC Premium Auto differentiates itself by stressing that all parts are OEM-approved, quality-tested, and backed by a verification process intended to ensure safety and durability at a lower price point than new components.

name: ACBM TECH
old_description: Shop for cash registers, commercial juicers, deli meat slicers, conveyor toasters, and more, all backed by our exceptional repair and maintenance services located in New York City.
about:
ACBM TECH operates a service shop and showroom at 184 Bowery in New York City's Lower East Side. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The business distributes and services a wide range of restaurant and retail equipment. Its product lineup includes SAM4s and HK Systems cash registers, OKPOS and Clover POS terminals, KIOSK systems, commercial juicers from brands such as Nutrifaster, Santos, Ceado, and Zumex, deli meat slicers, conveyor toasters, blenders, label-printing scales, Gardall safes, and time clocks. ACBM TECH also supplies service and delivery robots, digital signage, TV menu boards, and replacement parts for all supported equipment. The shop provides on-site repair and programming for cash registers, scales, juicers, blenders, conveyor toasters, and meat slicers, along with POS installation, merchant-account setup, and website design for hospitality clients.

Customers are primarily independent restaurants, cafes, delis, and other food-service or retail operators in the New York City area who need both equipment procurement and ongoing technical support.

ACBM TECH emphasizes that its inspection fee is waived when a repair proceeds, that all repairs carry a warranty period, and that its team aims to provide hassle-free installation and competitive merchant-service rates to minimize downtime for clients.
